claim_reviews.conclusion: The corrected cue “loneliness” matches the noun sense “sad because of a lack of companionship.”

response.rationale: Both forms are valid for the intended loneliness sense, but the relation is overstated: kesepian is also an ordinary Malaysian Malay form, so this is a usage preference rather than a clean language-specific contrast. No false-friend distinction is supported.
